entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I purchased recently.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. The online color just looks very different in person. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box is unopened.
I understand completely. Sometimes the lighting in photos can be tricky. Let me just pull up your order. Can I get your order number or the email address you used?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the helmet was delivered 23 days ago. You're well within our 90-day return window, so I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund immediately.

That's great news, thanks. I was planning on ordering a different one from your site. Since I have to go through the process of shipping this back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

I appreciate you asking and I'm glad you're sticking with VeloFit for your gear. For a standard return based on preference, I'm not able to generate a discount code. However, I have just emailed you a pre-paid return label. As soon as we receive the item, your full refund will be processed.
Okay, that's fair. I just thought it was worth a shot. A full refund works for me. I'm glad the process is straightforward.
Of course. We want to make sure you have the right gear. Your safety is our top priority, and that starts with a helmet you're happy with. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
